name: knowz-skills
description: Official Knowz plugin marketplace — knowledge management and structured AI development for Grok Build

plugins.name: knowz
plugins.description: Knowz vaults in Grok — /knowz-cli (knowz CLI, npm i -g @knowzai/cli) for search/save/ask/amend, plus /knowz and /knowz-auto. MCP is the fallback when the CLI is not installed.

plugins.name: knowzcode
plugins.description: Platform-agnostic AI development methodology with TDD, quality gates, and optional enterprise compliance. Commands: /knowzcode:work, /knowzcode:explore, /knowzcode:fix, /knowzcode:audit, /knowzcode:setup, /knowzcode:regroup, /knowzcode:relay, /knowzcode:status, /knowzcode:telemetry, /knowzcode:telemetry-setup, and /knowzcode:continue, plus automatic regroup-trigger and start-work routing.
